2318.o: Find someone who can translate the paladin’s journal.  The closest location that might have someone is Kargath, in the Badlands.

2338.o: Let Jarkal borrow the necklace.  In exchange, he will translate the journal for you.

2339.o: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.  Jarkal believes a power source might be found on the strongest construct present in Uldaman.$B$BFrom the journal, you know...$B* The ruby has been stashed in a barricaded Shadowforge area.$B* The topaz has been hidden in an urn in one of the Trogg areas, near some Alliance dwarves.$B* The sapphire has been claimed by Grimlok, the trogg leader.

2340.o: Deliver the Necklace and Gem Salvage to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.

2341.o: Visit Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath to see if he was successful.

2342.o: Get Patrick Garrett’s family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.

2358.o: Return the Horns of Nez’ra to Arantir’s Shadow in Lakeshire.

2359.o: Steal the Defias Tower Key, break into the Defias Tower and uncover the contents of the Duskwood Chest. Take whatever information you find back to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind. Read Kearnen’s Journal to gain insight about the tower.$B

2360.o: Travel to Westfall and find Agent Kearnen for your debriefing.

2378.o: Journey to Orgrimmar and speak with Shenthul at the Cleft of Shadow.

2379.o: Speak with Zando’zan at the Cleft of Shadow.

2380.o: Speak with Shenthul at the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

2381.o: Bring the Southsea Treasure back to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet. Do not forget to get an E.C.A.C. and Thieves’ Tools from Wrenix’s Gizmotronic Apparatus. You will need both of these items to complete your mission.$B$BShould you be attacked by any unusually hostile parrots, use your E.C.A.C.!$B$B

2382.o: Travel to Ratchet and speak with Wrenix the Wretched.

2383.o: Read the Simple Parchment and speak to Frang in the Valley of Trials.

2418.o: Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An’Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.

2438.o: Bring the Emerald Dreamcatcher to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.

2439.o: Take your reward voucher to Dinita Stonemantle in the Vault of Ironforge.

2440.o: Take the reward voucher to Bena Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff.

2458.o: Travel to the Venture Co. Tower, north of the Sludge Fen and contact the Shattered Hand’s covert operative, Taskmaster Fizzule.$B$BWhen the tower is in sight, use the Flare Gun to signal your arrival to Taskmaster Fizzule. Fire off TWO flares, then approach Taskmaster Fizzule and perform the Shattered /Salute.$B$BThese actions must be performed in the correct order, as Fizzule will attack and terminate any person he does not recognize.

2459.o: Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar wants you to kill 7 Gnarlpine Mystics and find the Missing Jewel.

2460.o: Perform the Shattered Salute on Shenthul.

2478.o: Steal Silixiz’s Tower Key from Foreman Silixiz, then kill two Mutated Venture Co. Drones, two Venture Co. Patrollers, and two Venture Co. Lookouts.$B$BAssassinate Grand Foreman Gallywix and take his head, then pick the lock on Gallywix’s lockbox and steal the Cache of Zanzil’s Altered Mixture. Take the Cache and Gallywix’s Head back to Shenthul in Orgrimmar for further instruction.$B

2479.o: Travel to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills and deliver the Sample of Zanzil’s Mixture to Serge Hinott.$B$BTo get to Tarren Mill, take the Zeppelin to the Undercity and follow the road south through Silverpine and towards Hillsbrad. Follow the signs!$B$B

2480.o: Wait for Serge Hinott to complete the cure.

2498.o: Rellian Greenspyre wants you to speak with Denalan at Lake Al’Ameth.

2499.o: Denalan at Lake Al’Ameth wants you to collect the Gargantuan Tumor from Oakenscowl.

2500.o: Acquire the reagents Ghak Healtouch needs from the Badlands, then return to him in Thelsamar.

2501.o: Use the empty thaumaturgy vessels on scorched guardian dragons found in the Badlands.  Once you have them filled, bring them to Ghak Healtouch in Thelsamar.

2518.o: Priestess A’moora in the Temple of the Moon at Darnassus wants you to bring her Lady Sathrah’s Silvery Spinnerets.

2519.o: Sister Aquinne wants you to speak with Priestess A’moora in the Temple of the Moon.

2520.o: Priestess A’moora wants you to place Lady Sathrah’s silvery spinnerets at the fountain inside the temple, and then return to her.

2521.o: In your journeys throughout the Blasted Lands, should you ever come across a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere, take the item back to Kum’isha the Collector.$B$BBe warned, this gem is one of the most rare crystals in all of Azeroth. Any creature in these lands could be holding a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere.$B$BYou will be rewarded for each Flawless Draenethyst Sphere you have collected.

2522.o: Find and return a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere to Kum’isha the Collector.

2541.o: Bring a Shaman Voodoo Charm to Oben Rageclaw in the Ban’ethil Barrow Den.
